scope: All Git-tracked filenames and decodable text scanned; targeted manual review of current package metadata, runtime naming, entry-point documentation, workflows, manuscript and supplement. Not a line-by-line correctness or security audit.
historical_policy: Dated source/evidence, imported experiment reports, upstream release notes and prior drafts retain original identities and paths. Current navigation and manuscript links are repaired; archival paths are interpreted through archives/catalog.jsonl and restoration guides. Compatibility aliases and internal brian2_rust paths remain supported.
external_urls: Network availability was not exhaustively checked; repository commit/path links are checked against local Git objects.
checks: git diff --check; current local link resolution; manuscript and translation rebuild; targeted Atlas naming/capability regression.

targeted_tests.scope: Fresh import order and legacy serialization; both names on reference/AOT; unsupported configuration/model and capability failure before execution.

runtime_change_scope: Docstrings and diagnostic labels only; Cargo description and documentation updated. No numerical, lowering or execution logic changes.
